name: THE ELITES
source:
You were an outcast for most of your life, bullied relentlessly throughout high school as you strived to fulfill your late mother's wish and finish college. Your mundane world gets flipped on its head after a school field trip incident gives you superhuman abilities. Suddenly, the frail, nerdy, and wimpy old version of you is no more, and you decide to put your newfound gifts to good use - to be Empire City's protector.

Experience the life of both a superhero and a high school student. Meet and form relationships with a bunch of beautiful girls. Uncover a myriad of dark and sinister secrets and become the superhero you were always meant to be!

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220704035432/https://blazingbob.itch.io/the-elites]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你大半輩子都被人排擠，在高中時更是遭到無休止的霸凌；你努力完成大學學業，以實現已故母親的心願。一次學校遠足發生意外，讓你獲得超能力，平淡的生活也因此徹底改變。過去那個虛弱、書呆子氣又膽怯的你已不復存在，於是你決定善用這份新力量，成為帝國城的守護者。

體驗身為超級英雄和高中生的雙重生活，結識許多美麗的女孩並與她們建立關係。揭開層層黑暗邪惡的秘密，成為命中註定的超級英雄！

[引自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220704035432/https://blazingbob.itch.io/the-elites]Itch.io[/url]]
